settings_dialog_reset_description: Are you sure you want to reset all settings to their default values? This will reset all parameters to the values provided by the server's /props endpoint and remove all your custom configurations.
settings_config_api_key: Set the API Key if you are using --api-key option for the server.
settings_config_system_message: The starting message that defines how model should behave.
settings_config_show_system_message: Display the system message at the top of each conversation.
settings_config_theme: Choose the color theme for the interface. You can choose between System (follows your device settings), Light, or Dark.
settings_config_paste_long_text: On pasting long text, it will be converted to a file. You can control the file length by setting the value of this parameter. Value 0 means disable.
settings_config_copy_text_attachments: When copying a message with text attachments, combine them into a single plain text string instead of a special format that can be pasted back as attachments.
settings_config_samplers: The order at which samplers are applied, in simplified way. Default is "top_k;typ_p;top_p;min_p;temperature": top_k->typ_p->top_p->min_p->temperature
settings_config_backend_sampling: Enable backend-based samplers. When enabled, supported samplers run on the accelerator backend for faster sampling.
settings_config_temperature: Controls the randomness of the generated text by affecting the probability distribution of the output tokens. Higher = more random, lower = more focused.
settings_config_dynatemp_range: Addon for the temperature sampler. The added value to the range of dynamic temperature, which adjusts probabilities by entropy of tokens.
settings_config_dynatemp_exponent: Addon for the temperature sampler. Smoothes out the probability redistribution based on the most probable token.
settings_config_top_p: Limits tokens to those that together have a cumulative probability of at least p
settings_config_min_p: Limits tokens based on the minimum probability for a token to be considered, relative to the probability of the most likely token.
settings_config_xtc_probability: XTC sampler cuts out top tokens; this parameter controls the chance of cutting tokens at all. 0 disables XTC.
settings_config_xtc_threshold: XTC sampler cuts out top tokens; this parameter controls the token probability that is required to cut that token.
settings_config_typ_p: Sorts and limits tokens based on the difference between log-probability and entropy.
settings_config_repeat_last_n: Last n tokens to consider for penalizing repetition
settings_config_repeat_penalty: Controls the repetition of token sequences in the generated text
settings_config_presence_penalty: Limits tokens based on whether they appear in the output or not.
settings_config_frequency_penalty: Limits tokens based on how often they appear in the output.
settings_config_dry_multiplier: DRY sampling reduces repetition in generated text even across long contexts. This parameter sets the DRY sampling multiplier.
settings_config_dry_base: DRY sampling reduces repetition in generated text even across long contexts. This parameter sets the DRY sampling base value.
settings_config_dry_allowed_length: DRY sampling reduces repetition in generated text even across long contexts. This parameter sets the allowed length for DRY sampling.
settings_config_dry_penalty_last_n: DRY sampling reduces repetition in generated text even across long contexts. This parameter sets DRY penalty for the last n tokens.
settings_config_max_tokens: The maximum number of token per output. Use -1 for infinite (no limit).
settings_config_custom: Custom JSON parameters to send to the API. Must be valid JSON format.
settings_config_show_thought: Expand thought process by default when generating messages.
settings_config_disable_reasoning: Send reasoning_format=none so the server returns thinking tokens inline instead of extracting them into a separate field.
settings_config_exclude_reasoning: Strip thinking from previous messages before sending. When off, thinking is sent back via the reasoning_content field so the model sees its own chain-of-thought across turns.
settings_config_show_raw_output: Show toggle button to display messages as plain text instead of Markdown-formatted content
settings_config_keep_stats: Keep processing statistics visible after generation finishes.
settings_config_show_stats: Display generation statistics (tokens/second, token count, duration) below each assistant message.
settings_config_ask_for_title: Ask for confirmation before automatically changing conversation title when editing the first message.
settings_config_use_first_line: Use only the first non-empty line of the prompt to generate the conversation title.
settings_config_pdf_as_image: Parse PDF as image instead of text. Automatically falls back to text processing for non-vision models.
settings_config_disable_autoscroll: Disable automatic scrolling while messages stream so you can control the viewport position manually.
settings_config_render_markdown: Render user messages using markdown formatting in the chat.
settings_config_always_sidebar: Always keep the sidebar visible on desktop instead of auto-hiding it.
settings_config_auto_sidebar: Automatically show sidebar when starting a new chat. Disable to keep the sidebar hidden until you click on it.
settings_config_send_on_enter: Use Enter to send messages and Shift + Enter for new lines. When disabled, use Ctrl/Cmd + Enter.
settings_config_auto_mic: Automatically show microphone button instead of send button when textarea is empty for models with audio modality support.
settings_config_full_height: Always display code blocks at their full natural height, overriding any height limits.
settings_config_raw_model_names: Display full raw model identifiers (e.g. "ggml-org/GLM-4.7-Flash-GGUF:Q8_0") instead of parsed names with badges.
settings_config_mcp_servers: Configure MCP servers as a JSON list. Use the form in the MCP Client settings section to edit.
settings_config_mcp_usage_stats: Usage statistics for MCP servers. Tracks how many times tools from each server have been used.
settings_config_agentic_max_turns: Maximum number of tool execution cycles before stopping (prevents infinite loops).
settings_config_agentic_max_tool_preview: Number of lines shown in tool output previews (last N lines). Only these previews and the final LLM response persist after the agentic loop completes.
settings_config_show_tool_call: Automatically expand tool call details while executing and keep them expanded after completion.
settings_config_py_interpreter: Enable Python interpreter using Pyodide. Allows running Python code in markdown code blocks.
settings_config_pre_encode: After each response, re-submit the conversation to pre-fill the server KV cache. Makes the next turn faster since the prompt is already encoded while you read the response.
settings_config_enable_continue: Enable "Continue" button for assistant messages. Currently works only with non-reasoning models.
settings_config_language: Select the display language for the interface. Machine translations may contain errors.
